notes.v1_4: Review pass 2 folded (REVIEW_PASS2_DISPOSITION_v1_0.md). Items depend only on items; a native act is an item with done_by decision whose id is a decisions-log id. Wave fix items (I.W0–I.W5) are derived from the level map; re-derive them, in the same commit as the plan, if the J1 LEVEL_MAP moves an asset.
notes.detector_types: v1.3 types built by L.13. New or changed in v1.4 (code items in REVIEW_PASS2_DISPOSITION): fk_no_cascade, acks_from, main_protected (new); deployed_contains and wave_deployed test ancestry (spec key test: ancestor); prs_merged and deployed_contains resolve head_refs; register_freeze_clean honours expect_rows; scorecard_pass checks generator hash and per-test verdicts; registry_coverage requires explicit keys; levels_elevated and assets_elevated read unknown until E6.3t. A type the code does not know yet reads unknown (error), never done.
notes.pinned_by: A detector spec with an empty list and pinned_by names who must fill it (paths or PR numbers); an empty spec reads unknown, never done.
notes.v1_4_1: Review pass 3 folded (REVIEW_PASS3_DISPOSITION_v1_0.md). New: E1.10 (R34, R36 closed; J1.R expects them), E0.1d/E0.1 (N-27: the Suvarṇa migration range 1200–1299 and the amendment of main's .claude/settings.json deny list; gate E3.2n, E3.2 and E7.1). E4.2r counts DEFERRED only with the withholding entry in force and the fix PR merged. E6.3t has a detector (the E6.3 function and its tracker-interface test on main). Wave items read membership from the J1-frozen LEVEL_MAP.json (spec key level_map). F3.FK names its target (no_fk; set_null if F-3 so rules). Spec keys the code does not read yet (level_map, target) are CODE items in the pass-3 disposition; until then they are ignored, never read as done.
notes.v1_5: Plan set v1.5 pre-final (N-28, N-29, N-30; the GPT-6 Astra review, INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_ASTRA_DISPOSITION_v1_0.md). Launch track: SS preparation NS.0, native setup NS.1–NS.9 (verified by the swarm through NS_VERIFY.json), launch gates LG.1–LG.8 and LG.10, v1.5 pre-final (L.19), dual review (L.20a, L.20b), reconciliation (L.21), final set (L.22), then FI-7 = N-1. Decision items are done only through the fail-closed gate evaluator (CODE-36). Items marked acceptance may not use a presence-only detector (LG.8). Detector types not yet built read unknown until their CODE item lands: evidence_verified (CODE-47), ci_job_passed (CODE-50), elevated_interface_ok (CODE-44); peer_tracker_item (CODE-54) is built. Spec keys the current code does not read (level_map_sha256, family_assets_sha256, ruleset_id, required_checks, expected_cells, ci_run_id, since) are CODE-40/45/48/49/55; until then those detectors must not be relied on (the lint flags them). Gochara items read Pravāha's tracker (peer_tracker_item); F2.5 removed (Pravāha D-SCOPE); F2.1 and F3.G split into F2.1a and F3.Ga/Gb/Gc.
